context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 added 5 new features: 1) Personal Loans (Piutang Pribadi) accessible from admin sidebar with full CRUD and payment tracking, 2) Farmer Debts (Hutang Petani) accessible from POS page via /pos/farmer-debts route with farmer management and debt transactions, 3) Daily Transactions page at /pos/daily-transactions replacing summary modal, 4) POS header now has Rincian and Hutang Petani buttons, 5) Transfer Stok dialog now uses product search input instead of dropdown. Dashboard asset formula updated to include personal loans and farmer debt. All new routes defined in App.js. Backend routes in loan_farmer_routes.py and transaction_routes.py.
